# test/tls/interop.sh (fakesh: tls12 hrr suite sid group zero dupext trail; fakesrv: ccs2 ccsflood

# columns (tab separated): case, expect, alerts, check, rfc, description
#   expect  OK            the client completes the GET (exit 0, the reply on stdout)
#           ABORT         the client fails with any TLSERR (never a hang, trap or exit 0)
#           ABORT:NAME    the client fails with TLS_ERR_NAME
#           ABORT_OR_OK   the RFC puts no requirement on the receiver; either outcome passes, no hang
#   alerts  the alert descriptions the client may send when it aborts (RFC 8446 section 6.2):
#           a list, "*" any (also none), "-" none expected (the peer already failed the session)
#   check   extra facts the server or stdout must show ("-" none): key=value from the server's
#           SRV line, or !out:TEXT (stdout must not contain TEXT)
